title: Shipshape and Bristol Fashion: Be Temple Worthy—in Good Times and Bad Times

notes_text: 1.  2 Nephi 2:13 . This scripture is part of a parallelism in the Book of Mormon. It is interesting that many of the prophets whose writings and sermons are included in the Book of Mormon used this literary approach to emphasize important doctrinal concepts. See, for example, 2 Nephi 9:25 (Jacob) and 2 Nephi 11:7 (Nephi).
